description: 完整轨迹 E30 全部预测与评分完成后，用相同合成输入和冻结系统在同 GPU 计时，不读真实 IQ 或真值。

data.representation: Exactly two deterministic synthetic G10 signals, repeated to batch 1 and 128; no real IQ or truth reads

permissions.regime: Frozen same F0/E0/PCD/density/threshold and original DURA vs fixed E30 flow; synthetic benchmark only
permissions.claim_scope: Hardware-specific timing of fixed already-evaluated systems; no new quality, target generalization, registration or blind-test claim; PCD target-U ancestry disclosed

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen scratch-trained E30 full-rollout flow vs original DURA graph; same original F0, E0, PCD, density and thresholds
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact E30 completed Phase3 prediction identity, runtime path, checkpoint and F0/E0/PCD ancestry
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: E30 full-rollout flow trained with frozen source F0 guidance; PCD carries historical target-U576 ancestry; no updates in this profile
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final E30 and DURA; all timing cases reported; no target-dependent choice

metric_names: full G+F0+E0+PCD+CPU density and threshold median and p95 latency

rows.method: Same frozen Phase3 systems with synthetic G10 inputs; original DURA graph vs full-rollout E30 flow eager
rows.seed_notes: fixed G10 synthetic phases and canonical channel seeds; same exact arrays to both pipelines
rows.scenario: two deterministic synthetic observations repeated to batch sizes 1 and 128

notes: Wait for the already-running rollout E30 and all its predictions/scoring to finish; strict checkpoint, F0/E0/PCD, thresholds and runtime binding, then actual-checkpoint synthetic smoke.

One empty GPU at admission, no known goal worker, same card and same synthetic inputs; compare DURA CUDA graph to eager rollout. Snapshots before/after each timing block catch observed same-card compute interference but not very brief unobserved activity.

Full system includes CPU input/output conversion, G, F0, E0, PCD, CPU density and thresholds. No true IQ, private truth, optimizer, threshold or model update; unequal quality precludes same-quality speedup claim.
Three focused profile tests and independent P0/P1 review passed; actual GPU profiling pending.
